_comment: create case pool: one row = one complete runnable case (productId + ownership fields embedded in the same row).
Discipline: every row must be same-source captured from a single real curl (create the order in the system's web UI + DevTools Copy as cURL);
assembling fields across rows/files is forbidden — a hand-built combination may be an ownership relationship that does not exist in reality (see README.md in this directory).
The dat file is located by the same-name convention: data/datfiles/products/<productId>/<productId>.dat; rows do not carry paths.
Row SHAPE recalibrated against a real environment capture (2026-08-10): basic gained direction/premiumAmount/premiumCurrency/iaCcy/
structuringInvolved/esgLinked/excludeFromCsa/breakClause. productId is the single product identifier (payload key, row field,
dat same-name convention — the former productType name was retired 2026-08-10). premiumDate is NOT a row field —
it is computed dynamically as T+2 business days at request time (an explicit premiumDate in a row overrides, for controlled experiments).
notionalCurrency may legitimately be an empty string (server infers); counterpartyFmId is an 8-digit-style numeric string;
portfolioId may differ per row. VALUES below remain placeholder fakes (well-formed, pass preflight) — real captured values live only
in the private copy and are never committed; record capture time and source in note.
